top_choice_rationale: P001 rewards a clue from nature turned into a mature, independently reproduced result: the magic-wavelength condition is a statement about atomic polarisabilities, 10^-18 uncertainty has been cross-checked by several laboratories, and it opens concrete tests of redshift, constants and dark matter. The Katori-Ye allocation is clean and the citation is built on the lattice concept, which separates it from the 2005 and 2012 prizes; the priority record (Lemonde, Takamoto, Ludlow) should still be verified by expert report. P002 is a reproduced prediction-plus-experiment but is younger with an unsettled mechanism and incomplete credit, so it ranks second, above no award.
recusal_note: none apparent from profile; as Secretary I would commission the expert check of the lattice-clock priority record without prejudging it
